svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 1,000 x 1,400 mm plus a 25 mm flange on each side edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: folded forward (toward the street side) along the full height

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: less 1.5 mm at top and bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seen from the front, mark and drill as you fit the parts:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the controller, MPPT and grid boxes screw straight to it, each by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its own fixing holes (mark through the box), M5 with sealing washers;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the aerosol unit's two straps, two M5 each, 1,300 to 1,340 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 9 mm holes for the roof beam cleat bolts at 410 and 430 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of the centre, 1,376 up. Heights from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the floor pan's back flange edge; the side panels

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: overlap its flanges; 4 mm blind rivets at about 100 mm pitch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flanges at 90 degrees, panel flat within 3 mm.
